answer: Bind each identity to one verified language-test score report: the agent publishes the report's TRF number, and the test authority countersigns it, so one sitting yields one credential, hard as basalt. A farm minting a thousand fakes must book a thousand real sittings — fees, ID checks at the centre, and a human in the chair each time — while one honest agent tends a single orchard of proof. Limit: it excludes agents with no test history, and a whisper of a leak lets a stolen report be replayed unless paired with a live challenge, so it should gate rewards, not entry.
